mapper.insert: insert into pay_order( client_request_id, request_fingerprint, create_stage, create_owner_token, create_lease_until, user_id, product_id, product_code, product_name, base_quota_snapshot, order_id, order_time, total_amount, status, market_type, group_activity_id, group_team_id, market_deduction_amount, pay_amount, create_time, update_time) values( #{clientRequestId}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{createStage}, #{createOwnerToken}, date_add(now(), interval 60 second), #{userId}, #{productId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{baseQuotaSnapshot}, #{orderId}, #{orderTime}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{marketType}, #{groupActivityId}, #{groupTeamId}, #{marketDeductionAmount}, #{payAmount}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, client_request_id, request_fingerprint, create_stage, create_owner_token, create_lease_until, user_id, product_id, product_code, product_name, base_quota_snapshot, order_id, order_time, total_amount, status, pay_url, pay_time, market_type, group_activity_id, group_team_id, market_deduction_amount, pay_amount from pay_order where user_id = #{userId} and client_request_id = #{clientRequestId} limit 1
mapper.update: update pay_order set create_owner_token = #{ownerToken}, create_lease_until = date_add(now(), interval 60 second), update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'CREATE' and create_stage in ('LOCAL_CREATED', 'GROUP_LOCKED') and (create_owner_token is null or create_lease_until is null or create_lease_until <= now())

update pay_order set create_owner_token = null, create_lease_until = null, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'CREATE' and create_owner_token = #{ownerToken} and create_stage in ('LOCAL_CREATED', 'GROUP_LOCKED')

update pay_order set create_stage = 'GROUP_LOCKED', market_type = #{marketType}, market_deduction_amount = #{marketDeductionAmount}, pay_amount = #{payAmount}, create_lease_until = date_add(now(), interval 60 second), update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'CREATE' and create_stage = 'LOCAL_CREATED' and create_owner_token = #{createOwnerToken}

update pay_order set create_stage = 'PROVIDER_STARTED', create_lease_until = date_add(now(), interval 60 second), update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'CREATE' and create_stage = 'GROUP_LOCKED' and create_owner_token = #{ownerToken}

update pay_order set pay_url = #{payUrl}, status = #{status}, market_type = #{marketType}, market_deduction_amount = #{marketDeductionAmount}, pay_amount = #{payAmount}, create_stage = 'PREPAY_READY', create_owner_token = null, create_lease_until = null, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'CREATE' and create_stage = 'PROVIDER_STARTED' and create_owner_token = #{createOwnerToken}

update pay_order set create_stage = 'MANUAL_REVIEW', create_owner_token = null, create_lease_until = null, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'CREATE' and create_stage = 'PROVIDER_STARTED' and create_owner_token = #{ownerToken}
update pay_order set pay_url = #{payUrl}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'PAY_WAIT'
update pay_order set status = #{status}, pay_time = ifnull(#{payTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, now()), update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status in ('CREATE', 'PAY_WAIT')
update pay_order set status = 'CLOSE', update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status in ('CREATE', 'PAY_WAIT')
mapper.select: SELECT order_id as orderId FROM pay_order WHERE status = 'PAY_WAIT' AND NOW() >= order_time + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 50
SELECT order_id as orderId FROM pay_order WHERE status = 'PAY_WAIT' AND NOW() >= order_time + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT user_id, order_id, status, market_type, pay_amount, pay_time, settlement_notified FROM pay_order WHERE status = 'PAY_SUCCESS' AND market_type = 1 AND settlement_notified = 0 AND NOW() >= update_time + INTERVAL 2 MINUTE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20
mapper.update: update pay_order set settlement_notified = 1, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and settlement_notified = 0
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, order_id, status, market_type, pay_amount, pay_time FROM pay_order WHERE status = 'WAIT_REFUND' AND NOW() >= update_time + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20

select id, client_request_id, request_fingerprint, create_stage, create_owner_token, create_lease_until, user_id, product_id, product_code, product_name, base_quota_snapshot, order_id, order_time, total_amount, status, pay_url, pay_time, market_type, group_activity_id, group_team_id, market_deduction_amount, pay_amount, settlement_notified, create_time, update_time from pay_order where order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: update pay_order set status = 'DEAL_DONE', update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'PAY_SUCCESS'
mapper.select: select id, client_request_id, request_fingerprint, create_stage, create_owner_token, create_lease_until, user_id, product_id, product_code, product_name, base_quota_snapshot, order_id, order_time, total_amount, status, pay_url, pay_time, market_type, group_activity_id, group_team_id, market_deduction_amount, pay_amount, settlement_notified, create_time, update_time from pay_order where user_id = #{userId} and order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: update pay_order set status = 'CLOSE', update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and order_id = #{orderId} and status != 'CLOSE'
update pay_order set status = 'WAIT_REFUND', update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and order_id = #{orderId} and status in ('PAY_SUCCESS', 'MARKET', 'DEAL_DONE')
